__broaden__.cedat: cēdō, -ere, cessī, cessum — to go, yield, give way (3rd sg. pres. subj., after nē) · also after nī, unless (ni Turnus cedat)
__broaden__.cruenta: cruentus, -a, -um — bloody, blood-stained (f. abl. sg.) · also n. acc. pl. (arma cruenta)
__broaden__.dedit: dō, dare, dedī, datum — to give; to grant (+ inf.) (3rd sg. perf.) · also dicta dedit, uttered, spoke · also sē dare, to hurl oneself (in fluvium dedit)
__broaden__.ediderit: ēdō, -ere, -didī, -ditum — to put forth, produce, bring about (3rd sg. perf. subj. act., indirect question) · also in an indignant question (potential subj.)

__broaden__.palantisque: palor, -ārī, -ātus sum — to wander, stray, roam (pres. part., f. acc. pl., i-stem form) + -que, and · also m. acc. pl. (palantisque socios)
__broaden__.sufficit: sufficiō, -ere, -fēcī, -fectum — to supply, furnish, put in (3rd sg. pres.) · also to hold out, be equal to (nec sufficit umbo)
